I audited the repo against CLAUDE.md. Here is everything that currently breaks a rule, and what I intend to change. Note: I have no write/shell tool in plan mode, so I can only read until you approve; and `ln -s`/file edits will need a shell/write tool to be enabled.

**Rule 1 — skills/agents live in `plugins/`, linked into `.claude/`**
1. `.claude/skills/quick-notes/` is a real skill with no plugin behind it. Needs a home under `plugins/`, then a symlink.
2. `.claude/skills/x-image` link is missing entirely (plugin skill exists at `plugins/x-assistant/skills/x-image/`).
3. `.claude/skills/voice-video` is a **broken** symlink: it points at `../../plugins/avatar-video/skills/voice_video` (underscore) instead of `voice-video` (hyphen).
4. `.claude/agents/x-reviewer.md` link is missing.

**Rule 6 — `plugin.json` (name = folder, version, description) + marketplace entry**
5. `plugins/diagrams/.claude-plugin/plugin.json`: `"name": "diagram"` ≠ folder `diagrams`.
6. `plugins/diagrams` is absent from `.claude-plugin/marketplace.json`.
7. `plugins/avatar-video/.claude-plugin/plugin.json`: no `description`.
8. `plugins/outlook-email/.claude-plugin/plugin.json`: no `version`.

**Rule 7 — frontmatter needs `name` + `description`**
9. `plugins/x-assistant/skills/xhs-post/SKILL.md`: no `description`.
10. `plugins/avatar-video/agents/video-scripter.md`: no `name`.

**Rule 8 — README row per skill/subagent**
11. Missing row for `plugins/x-assistant/skills/youtube-post/`.
12. Missing row for `plugins/avatar-video/agents/video-reviewer.md`.

**Rule 9** — I will not touch `heygen-avatar`, `heygen-video`, `hyperframes`, `media-use`.

Planned edits: fix the two plugin.json gaps + diagrams name; add the diagrams marketplace entry; add the missing frontmatter fields; add the two README rows; create the missing `.claude` links and repoint `voice-video`; move `quick-notes` into a plugin and symlink it. Then read every touched file back to confirm.

One decision I need from you: **where should `quick-notes` live?** Its content is generic note-taking, so it fits no existing plugin (x-assistant, avatar-video, outlook-email, diagrams). My default is to create `plugins/quick-notes/` — a new plugin with `plugin.json`, `skills/quick-notes/SKILL.md`, a marketplace entry and a README row — but tell me if you'd rather it go under an existing plugin (e.g. `x-assistant`).

I also cannot verify whether the *working* `.claude/skills/*` links are true symlinks or plain copies (reading resolves either way); if any are copies, regenerating all of them with `ln -s` would be included.
